Automatic full-song duration and scene planner

inputs.global_creative_prompt: Create a coherent cinematic music video that follows this scene outline in song-time order. For every scene, match the instruction whose time range contains the TIMING interval printed below. [0-10s | OPENING] Begin in a quiet, atmospheric location; the performer looks toward camera and slowly raises their gaze. [10-30s | VERSE] Move to a related location; the performer walks slowly past practical lights, then turns toward camera. [30-50s | CHORUS] Build energy with a wider setting, wind moving the wardrobe, and a restrained expressive hand gesture. [50-70s | BRIDGE] Shift to an intimate close-up with a reflective pause and softer movement. [70s onward | FINAL CHORUS / ENDING] Return to the opening visual motif, build to a confident final pose, then hold still. Adapt these example time ranges and actions to the actual song: edit them to describe your intended scenes, settings, events, and transitions. Preserve the same performer identity, face, hair, wardrobe, and visual continuity unless a scene explicitly changes them.
inputs.performer_description: The same lead performer shown in the reference picture. Define the character here: age range, facial features, hair, wardrobe, accessories, posture, expression, and any identity details that must remain consistent.
inputs.visual_style: Cinematic music video; specify the color palette, lighting, atmosphere, environment detail, lens character, depth of field, and realism level you want.
inputs.camera_pattern:
wide establishing shot, slow dolly-in, stable horizon
medium tracking shot from the front, smooth movement
intimate face close-up, gentle restrained push-in
wide profile shot, slow lateral tracking movement
inputs.non_vocal_action: Describe what the performer does during instrumental passages, such as looking away, breathing, walking, turning, or holding a pose. Keep mouth naturally closed when not singing.
